title: anthemis cretica subsp. iberica
intro: Anthemis cretica subsp. iberica, commonly known as Iberian chamomile, is a subspecies of the Anthemis cretica plant, which is a perennial herb in the daisy family native to southern Europe and western Asia. This plant is known for its calming and soothing properties, which are used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Iberian chamomile include reducing inflammation, promoting relaxation, and relieving menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Iberian chamomile are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative effects.
